dz: 埃克内斯镇(芬兰语:Tammisaari)由瑞典国王古斯塔夫·瓦萨所建立.
de: The town of Ekenäs (Finnish: Tammisaari) is founded by King Gustav Vasa of Sweden.

t: 摩尔达维亚的斯蒂芬三世在巴亚战役中击败了匈牙利的马蒂亚斯·科尔维努斯,后者被打成三伤.
te: Stephen III of Moldavia defeats Matthias Corvinus of Hungary, with the latter being injured thrice, at the Battle of Ba…
dz: 摩尔达维亚的斯蒂芬三世在巴亚战役中击败了匈牙利的马蒂亚斯·科尔维努斯,后者被打成三伤.
de: Stephen III of Moldavia defeats Matthias Corvinus of Hungary, with the latter being injured thrice, at the Battle of Baia.

t: 格尔德库赫的尼扎里·伊斯梅利驻军,波斯17后向蒙古人投降.
te: The Nizari Ismaili garrison of Gerdkuh, Persia surrender after 17 years to the Mongols.
dz: 格尔德库赫的尼扎里·伊斯梅利驻军,波斯17后向蒙古人投降.
de: The Nizari Ismaili garrison of Gerdkuh, Persia surrender after 17 years to the Mongols.

t: 胡拉古统治下的蒙古军队进入并拆除了位于阿拉穆特城堡(今伊朗)的尼扎里·伊斯梅利(刺客)据点,作…
te: Mongol forces under Hulagu enter and dismantle the Nizari Ismaili (Assassin) stronghold at Alamut Castle (in present-da…
dz: 胡拉古统治下的蒙古军队进入并拆除了位于阿拉穆特城堡(今伊朗)的尼扎里·伊斯梅利(刺客)据点,作为对伊斯兰西南亚的进攻的一部分.
de: Mongol forces under Hulagu enter and dismantle the Nizari Ismaili (Assassin) stronghold at Alamut Castle (in present-day Iran) as part of their offensive on Islamic southwest Asia.

t: 西西里人总理斯蒂芬·德·佩尔切将皇家宫廷迁至墨西拿来防止叛乱.
te: Sicilian Chancellor Stephen du Perche moves the royal court to Messina to prevent a rebellion.
dz: 西西里人总理斯蒂芬·德·佩尔切将皇家宫廷迁至墨西拿来防止叛乱.
de: Sicilian Chancellor Stephen du Perche moves the royal court to Messina to prevent a rebellion.

t: 晋朝皇帝万年梁相继在开西会战中被军事击败后,由军官密谋出击,于是在其营中刺杀帝.
te: Military officers conspire against the emperor Wanyan Liang of the Jin dynasty after a military defeat at the Battle of…
dz: 晋-宋战争:晋朝皇帝万年梁相继在开西会战中被军事击败后,由军官密谋出击,于是在其营中刺杀帝.
de: Jin–Song wars: Military officers conspire against the emperor Wanyan Liang of the Jin dynasty after a military defeat at the Battle of Caishi, and assassinate the emperor at his camp.

t: 君士坦丁八世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一皇帝,在被加冕为同帝后63年.
te: Constantine VIII becomes sole emperor of the Byzantine Empire, 63 years after being crowned co-emperor.
dz: 君士坦丁八世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一皇帝,在被加冕为同帝后63年.
de: Constantine VIII becomes sole emperor of the Byzantine Empire, 63 years after being crowned co-emperor.

t: 教宗塞尔吉乌斯一世被选为反帕夏尔和西奥多之间的妥协.
te: Pope Sergius I is elected as a compromise between antipopes Paschal and Theodore.
dz: 教宗塞尔吉乌斯一世被选为反帕夏尔和西奥多之间的妥协.
de: Pope Sergius I is elected as a compromise between antipopes Paschal and Theodore.

t: 拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯在特里卡马鲁姆战役中击败了由国王盖利默所指挥的万达人.
te: Byzantine general Belisarius defeats the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, at the Battle of Tricamarum.
dz: 万达利克会战:拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯在特里卡马鲁姆战役中击败了由国王盖利默所指挥的万达人.
de: Vandalic War: Byzantine general Belisarius defeats the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, at the Battle of Tricamarum.
